note: vespera_macro fixes: schema_type! of a SeaORM Local column with a SQL-function default (NOW()) compiles again; same-named types in sibling inline modules of one file resolve to the right module for schema! / schema_type! / default functions; schema_type! carries serde default values into the derived component; Multipart derives on generic types add the Default bounds their defaults need; a stale route or cron registration is dropped only inside rust-analyzer; two export_app! of one crate with the same name are a compile error; derived garde validation skips serde-skipped fields, does not nest flattened field paths, peels nested Option, keeps bounds beyond 2^53 exact (and loosened to the documented f64 so runtime and OpenAPI agree) and rejects non-finite bounds; a default on a $ref property is documented as a sibling; more literal defaults are resolved (negative numbers, to_owned / into / to_string, String::new / Vec::new, JSON array / object strings); a renamed self-referencing type resolves to its own component; invalid route file name suggestions are valid identifiers; OAuth2 flows reject URL fields they do not take; raw-identifier modules, Path<()> and inline modules in rust-analyzer resolve; use x::{self} aliases resolve for merge; merge route conflicts are checked before any spec file is written; a sidecar spec without a fingerprint falls back to its content hash; escaped braces and percent escapes are one route shape for overlap checks; the cron module-tree scan runs only with the cron feature and ignores a cron attribute imported from another crate.
